junction_identity.interpretation: The terminal states remain extremely far from the exact combined junction manifold in this coordinate/residual representation. This is a diagnostic statement about the frozen numerical path, not a continuum nonexistence proof.

ranked_failure_modes.label: BOUNDARY_MANIFOLD_SEED_MISMATCH
evidence: The exact combined junction condition requires 7*A_sum + ell_sum = 2 at lambda_hat=1.
All seven N96 terminal states remain between approximately 3.3e-6 and 3.97e-3 in 7*A_sum + ell_sum.
R_4D + R_chi therefore remains approximately 1.996 to 2.000.
All 35 stages restart from the frozen control-seed family rather than a boundary-manifold-informed continuation state.
ranked_failure_modes.not_claimed: No statement that the exact junction manifold has no global solution.

ranked_failure_modes.label: EQUILIBRATED_TRUST_SPACE_STEP_SQUEEZE
evidence: Every one of 1785 recorded ETRN trial iterations was accepted; none was rejected.
At N96 rho stays close to one and the trust radius reaches its frozen maximum 64 for every seed.
The unconstrained equilibrated step norm at N96 is approximately 1.89e8 to 4.62e8, so the active trust radius is only approximately 1.38e-7 to 3.38e-7 of that norm.
The N96 terminal state moves only approximately 1.06e-5 to 1.13e-5 in relative Euclidean norm from its frozen seed before the stagnation rule fires.
ranked_failure_modes.not_claimed: No automatic permission to enlarge the trust radius or alter scaling in CP01R2.

ranked_failure_modes.label: PROGRESS_CONTINUATION_NEVER_ACTIVATED
evidence: The frozen continuation rule requires final <= 0.90 * initial.
No stage reaches that threshold; the best relative stage improvement is approximately 0.7993 percent.
All 35 records identify their initialization as FRESH_FROZEN_CP01R1_SEED_SAME_INDEX and no continuation source entry is recorded.
ranked_failure_modes.not_claimed: This is not a protocol defect; it is the exact realized path under the frozen rule.

ranked_failure_modes.label: N96_DISCRETE_RANK_DEFICIENCY_NOT_PRIMARY_EXPLANATION
evidence: All seven N96 CP01R2 diagnostics report raw discrete rank 776/776.
All reported N96 condition estimates are below 1e12.
Despite this, all seven N96 stages stagnate without a local root and retain O(1) boundary residuals.
ranked_failure_modes.not_claimed: Full discrete rank is not continuum invertibility and does not establish existence.

diagnostic_conclusion: The preserved CP01R2 data support a combined diagnosis: the frozen seed family remains far from the exact combined junction manifold, while the equilibrated trust-region method accepts locally accurate but heavily clipped steps and never achieves the progress threshold required to activate mesh continuation. Improved N96 discrete rank/conditioning does not remove the boundary obstruction. This narrows the numerical failure mode but does not prove continuum nonexistence.
d11_design_requirements: preserve the physical M1 parameter point and topology unless a separately named new experiment is explicitly authorized
derive boundary-manifold-aware initialization constraints from the exact frozen junction equations rather than fitting result data
separate seed construction from physical acceptance thresholds
test scaling/trust geometry only on analytic or manufactured systems before any physical release review
define any changed seed set with a new seed_set_id and SHA-256
define any changed nonlinear method or continuation rule under a new run_id
retain the original CP01R1 and CP01R2 results as immutable negative numerical outcomes
